title: E. coli K-12 MG1655 rrlC/rrsC ribosome structure visualization pressure fixtures

purpose.productPath: Open MG1655 -> right-click rrlC or rrsC RNA annotation -> Show Structure -> hover large ribosome candidates and loaded ribosome residues.
purpose.failureClass: Large MolStar preview cache/load handoff must not leave the visible drawer target blank before the loading UI attaches.
acceptanceOracles: Preview candidate row switches to preview state.
The active drawer viewer target shows a React-owned loading overlay immediately after the target cache key changes.
The MolStar loading container is attached before the structure parse completes.
No blank target samples appear without an overlay.
Structure bytes are served from local RCSB fixture files.
Loaded ribosome residue letters show hover frames and React hover state within bounded pointer-to-highlight latency.
Loaded 9Q87 MolStar canvas hover events stay coalesced and do not block the renderer during pointer sweeps.
Loaded rrsC ribosome candidates must never reach a ligand/ion-only MolStar state when the render plan expects visible polymer.
